Cost of sales is 92,676 for 2025 and 84,771 for 2024, leading to a Gross Profit of 39,572 and 37,293, reflecting a 6.1% increase. Total Operating Expenses are 13,061 for 2025 and 11,444 for 2024, resulting in an Operating Profit of 26,511 and 25,849 (2.6% growth). The Operating Margin is 20.0% for 2025 and 21.2% for 2024. Profit before income taxes is 29,199 and 27,945, with an Income Tax Expense of 8,234 and 8,233. The Net Profit after non-controlling interests is 20,939 for 2025 and 19,680 for 2024, with Basic EPS at 50.64 and 47.52 respectively, indicating a 6.6% growth.
